rationale: The original thesis relied on trading well below session VWAP with a steady sequence of lower highs and lower lows. Since hitting the session low of $91.20 (giving up +1.41% maximum favorable excursion), price has rebounded 2.27% to reclaim session VWAP ($93.08) at $93.27 and transitioned into higher lows on the 1-minute timeframe. Because the invalidation was conceptualized as just above VWAP and VWAP has declined while price bounced above it, the breakdown momentum has failed.
